title: OpenDecision
description: An unruled fork: a question with mutually exclusive options the human (or a downstream ruling) must settle. Written to init/decisions/open/<id>.md. An open decision blocks planning until ruled.

id.description: Stable lowercase-kebab slug; the filename stem.

question.description: The fork stated as a single decidable question.

context.description: Why this fork exists and what depends on it.

options.description: At least two mutually exclusive options with their tradeoffs.
